segments.he: אוֹ שֶׁיָּשְׁבָה. יָשְׁבָה — אִין, לֹא יָשְׁבָה — לָא.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: Or if she was occupied with the removal of blood stains from the garments of other women or from her own garment, from any source, such as blood that originated from a wound elsewhere on her body or even her own menstrual blood from a prior menstrual cycle; «or if she sat» alongside others who were occupied with removing blood stains. The Gemara infers: If she knows for certain that «she sat» alongside those occupied with removing blood stains, «yes,» she may attribute blood to this source. But if she does «not» know for certain that «she sat» alongside those who were removing blood stains, but knows only that she was in the same area as they were, she may «not» attribute blood to this source.

moves.about: lemma: or if she sat alongside those handling stains

moves.summary: sat: yes; did not certainly sit: no
moves.about: only if she knows she sat beside them may she attribute; mere uncertainty does not suffice
